# Gush AI E-Commerce Chatbot

[![License: GPL v2](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPL_v2-blue.svg)](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html)
[![WordPress Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/WordPress-Plugin-blue.svg)](https://wordpress.org/plugins/)

An intelligent, Intercom-style AI shopping assistant and 24/7 personal customer service agent for WooCommerce stores, powered by the **Gush AI Cognitive Gateway**.

## 🚀 Features

- Modern Intercom-style chat widget for WooCommerce stores
- Custom business service instructions and policies
- Real-time WooCommerce product catalog integration
- Admin dashboard for monitoring conversations
- Multi-turn conversation memory
- Secure server-to-server API gateway

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the latest release ZIP
2. Upload via WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New → Upload
3. Activate the plugin
4. Configure your API settings in Gush AI Chat → Agent Settings

## 🔑 Getting Your API Key

1. Visit [Gush AI Gateway](https://api.sstore.ng/store)
2. Generate your API access token
3. Paste it in WordPress admin under Gush AI Chat settings
